templateDescriptions.ai-balanced: AI-aware profile with region and service controls.
templateDescriptions.ai-strict: Fail-closed AI profile with account protections.

builderDescription: Choose routing preferences and create an opaque subscription URL that redirects to the `.ini` template.
converterDescription: Combine proxy links and subscriptions into one YAML profile for manual node selection.
excludeRegions: Use all regions except the ones I select
onlyRegions: Use only the regions I select
regionsHelpExclude: Excluded regions are removed from regional, stable, and generic node groups.
regionsHelpOnly: Only selected routable regions are candidates; unknown nodes are excluded.
preferredRegionHelp: Optional. Changes the displayed candidate order for active regions only.
serviceHelp: Clearing a service disables its route and sends that service to REJECT.
preferredServiceHelp: Optional. Changes selector display and candidate order; it never changes routing priority.
allowDirectHelp: When disabled, direct choices and routes are blocked, including local and direct-routing exceptions.
failClosedHelp: Manual selectors start at REJECT, so choose a permitted route after import. Protected account safeguards remain enforced even when this option is off.

previewCurrent: Preview matches the current editor settings.

saveFailed: Could not save this profile. Try again.

missingManagement: Management link is missing a profile ID or capability token.
inputFormatHelp: Paste one link per line. Auto detect combines different proxy types and approved subscription URLs. Choose “Proxy links” for HTTPS proxies. Paste Clash YAML or Base64 subscription content as one complete input.
converterInputLabel: Proxy links, subscription URLs, or pasted subscription content
inputPrivacy: Input stays in this page’s memory and is sent only to this converter. YAML may contain credentials; clear it when finished.
outputHelp: Select a node in a regional group, then choose that region in the pinned selector. With fail closed enabled, also select allowed routes for DNS and the services you use. Selections stay manual.
inputRequired: Paste a proxy link or subscription content first.
clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.

subscriptionHostDisabled: This subscription host is not enabled by the service operator.
serviceGroupRoutesHelp: Choose a group, assign services, and arrange exits. Preview reviews edits; creating or saving a profile, or converting to YAML, includes them.
iniTemplateScope: Generates an OpenClash custom-template subscription URL using this template.
yamlTemplateScope: Renders a YAML profile using this template and its routing options.
chooseOrCreateGroup: Choose a group or create one to begin.
deleteGroupHelp: Services in a deleted group stay blocked until assigned to another group.
groupRouteOrderHelp: Drag to arrange manual choices. This order does not enable automatic failover or switch your IP.
groupStartBlockedHelp: When checked, REJECT is selected on import. Choose an exit in your proxy client to allow this service.
protectedStartBlockedHelp: Required for account protection. Choose an approved exit in your proxy client after import.
globalStartBlockedHelp: Required by the global fail-closed setting. Choose an exit in your proxy client after import.
routeUnavailableService: Not allowed by this group's service policies.
allGroupRoutesAdded: All permitted exits are already in this group.
restoreServiceGroupsHelp: This replaces all edited groups, service assignments, and exit orders with the selected template.
resetGroupRoutesHelp: Replace this group's exit choices with the template defaults.
invalidGroupName: Use a unique group name that is not reserved by the template and contains no delimiters or control characters.
protectedGroupRoutes: Account protection stays separate. This group cannot be renamed, deleted, or merged; REJECT stays first and only approved exits are available.
emptyGroupRoutes: Drop an exit here. With no exits, this group rejects traffic.
emptyGroupServices: Drop services here. An empty group has no matching traffic.
incompatibleGroupRoutes: Remove exits that this service does not allow before moving it into this group.
